players.product: BUZZ HPC GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB200 / GB300 / B200 / H200 clusters in Bell AI Fabric data centers in Canada) plus HPC colocation conversions of owned sites (Boden Sweden, Toronto gigafactory)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 10-Q: on November 17, 2025 it announced the purchase of 504 Nvidia Blackwell B200 GPUs installed in 63 Dell XE9680L servers with InfiniBand (its first liquid-cooled next-generation GPU deployment) for the Bell Canada AI Fabric data center in Manitoba. On February 13, 2026 BUZZ signed customer agreements representing approximately $30 million in total contract value over two-year fixed terms for these GPUs; originally expected online in the quarter ending March 31, 2026, the units became operational in May 2026. Management expects this initial phase to generate approximately $15 million of projected ARR once fully operational, lifting total annualized HPC segment revenue from approximately $20 million to approximately $35 million.
quarterly_data.figure: 504 B200 GPUs in 63 Dell XE9680L servers; ~$30 million TCV over two-year terms; ~$15 million ARR; annualized HPC revenue ~$20 million to ~$35 million

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 10-Q business objectives: over the next 36 months it anticipates HPC expansion capital expenditures of up to approximately $493 million — approximately $61 million for strategic land acquisitions for data center expansion (including land in Ontario, Canada), approximately $150 million of infrastructure buildout, up to approximately $150 million for GPU acquisitions for HPC and AI workloads, and up to approximately $132 million for GPUs to deploy in data centers under its teaming agreement with Bell Canada announced August 19, 2025; $88.8 million has been spent to date. It intends to spend approximately $35 million to transition the Toronto Facility to a Tier-III data center ($nil spent so far). The planned 100 MW substation expansion at Yguazu, Paraguay ($15 million estimate, $13.5 million spent) is targeted for calendar 2026, with construction commenced and key infrastructure components ordered.
quarterly_data.figure: HPC capex up to ~$493 million over 36 months ($88.8 million spent); Toronto Tier-III conversion ~$35 million; Yguazu 100 MW substation $15 million ($13.5 million spent)

quarterly_data.signal: HIVE's 10-Q site table (operational hashrate, MW utilized, MW capacity available) as of July 31, 2026: its sites in total used 393.1 MW of 464.0 MW of power capacity available; the hosted facilities, which list no hashrate (N/A), were Quebec City (0.7 MW of 0.7 MW), Montreal (1.4 MW of 1.4 MW), Stockholm (0.4 MW of 0.4 MW) and Manitoba (1.0 MW utilized of 4.0 MW available).
quarterly_data.figure: 393.1 MW utilized of 464.0 MW available; Manitoba hosted facility 1.0 MW of 4.0 MW
